entities.name: Query CTP synthase
observations: 533 aa protein; estimated molecular weight 60.37 kDa and theoretical pI 5.98.
Has CTP synthase N-terminal domain PF06418.21 at residues 3-265 and glutamine amidotransferase domain PF00117.35 at residues 302-525.
Sequence is homologous to reviewed bacterial CTP synthases at 62.6-63.5% identity with 99% coverage and E-values approximately 10^-249 to 10^-250.
Likely catalyzes ATP-dependent conversion of UTP to CTP using glutamine or ammonia as nitrogen source; exact activity is homology-based rather than directly assayed for this sequence.
Likely forms a homotetramer and functions in de novo pyrimidine/CTP biosynthesis, based on reviewed homolog annotations.
Predicted cytosolic soluble enzyme; no transmembrane segment or signal peptide is evident from the sequence-derived profile.
Sequence-derived properties: instability index 32.45, GRAVY -0.3105, charge at pH 7 approximately -10.6.

entities.name: Q927T4
observations: Reviewed Listeria innocua CTP synthase; 62.6% identity and 99.8% query coverage to the query sequence.
Annotated EC 6.3.4.2; catalyzes ATP-dependent UTP amination to CTP with L-glutamine or ammonia.
Annotated homotetramer, cytosolic localization, de novo CTP biosynthesis, GTP activation with glutamine, and CTP feedback inhibition.

entities.name: CTP synthesis from UTP
observations: UTP + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O yields CTP + L-glutamate + ADP + phosphate; mapped to Rhea RHEA:26426 in annotated homologs.
Alternative ammonia-dependent reaction is UTP + NH4+ + ATP yielding CTP + ADP + phosphate; mapped to Rhea RHEA:16597.

entities.name: De novo CTP biosynthesis
observations: Query protein is assigned by strong homology to the pyrimidine metabolism step converting UTP to CTP.
